request.style: English, male baritone, solo with choir, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, organ, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Your obedience is known to everyone
I rejoice over you in this light
Be wise in what is good, dear friends
And innocent in what is evil

[Chorus]
The God of peace will soon crush Satan
Under your feet, the battle is won
Grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
Be with you now and forever

[Verse]
Watch out for those who create divisions
Put obstacles in your holy way
They do not serve our Lord Christ
But their own appetites instead

[Chorus]
The God of peace will soon crush Satan
Under your feet, the battle is won
Grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
Be with you now and forever

[Bridge]
Smooth talk and flattery deceive
The hearts of the unsuspecting blind
Keep away from such false teachers
Who twist the teaching you have learned

[Chorus]
The God of peace will soon crush Satan
Under your feet, the battle is won
Grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
Be with you now and forever

[Outro]
Grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
Be with you now
